previousScreenshotCorrection.cause: The browser selector matched an adjacent September 28 instead of October 28. The actual range was September 28 to October 26. Highlighting October 1 through 26 was consistent with that range; this was not proof of selecting October 26 to 28.
previousScreenshotCorrection.regression: Explicit adjacent-month selection now asserts September 28 to October 26; normal browser and test selectors use current-month cells.

fixes.cedar: Remove mouseleave falsely emitting mouseenter; leaving the range calendars clears a pending hover preview and preserves its selected endpoint.
fixes.maple: Shared day/month/year highlight calculation ignores missing/invalid endpoints rather than parsing undefined as today; reversed bounds normalized for drawing.

checks.lint: Cedar affected files and Maple root lint passed

hoverVerification: Component event tests cover Cedar hover and leave without publishing a selection; Maple keeps click/touch selection unchanged on mouseenter. Native browser validation covered actual date clicks and committed model values.
